title: Rappler Live Jam: J2X
summary: Choreographer-turned-recording artist J2X brings his hip-hop and electronic charm to Rappler Live Jam!

blocks.text: Choreographer-turned-recording artist J2X brings his hip-hop and electronic charm to Rappler Live Jam!
MANILA, Philippines – J2X makes his Rappler Live Jam debut on Thursday, October 29!

J2X, whose real name is Jay Joseph Roncesvales first made waves in the entertainment industry as a choreographer, working with acclaimed P-pop act SB19 and dance group W3 to shape their movements on stage.
Now, as a singer-songwriter, he blends the sounds of hip-hop and electronic music, shining best through songs like “EDEWUP” and “AKONGAPALASI.”
Catch J2X on Rappler Live Jam on Thursday, 8 pm, by bookmarking this page or heading to Rappler’s YouTube! – Rappler.com
